triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '37. Full-draining VMEM after `ds_bpermute` wastes the no-mask rescale window' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 37. Full-draining VMEM after `ds_bpermute` wastes the no-mask rescale window

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL Flash Attention on MI308X (gfx942) -- 37. Full-draining VMEM after `ds_bpermute` wastes the no-mask rescale window

payload.attempted: A softmax row reduction uses `ds_bpermute`, so the obvious safe wait is `s_waitcnt vmcnt(0) lgkmcnt(0)` immediately after it. That guarantees the LDS permute is complete and also drains any outstanding V global loads.
payload.lesson: In no-mask FlashAttention, wait for the dependency you actually need. Do not full-drain VMEM at a reduction boundary unless the next instruction consumes the VMEM data.

established_fact.mechanism: `lgkmcnt(0)` is sufficient to consume the cross-lane reduction result. The V loads are independent at that point, so draining VMEM early removes a latency-hiding window the kernel can fill with VALU rescale work.
